name: tharigopula-clinical-os

scripts.//deploy:api: Worker releases are committed, migration-clean, fully tested, dry-run, strict and tagged with their git commit. The guarded script refuses any missing condition.
scripts.//deploy:web: NEVER 'wrangler pages deploy .' here. The repository root holds .dev.vars, the Worker source, the schema, the migrations and the internal documents, and Pages publishes every one of them. On 7 Sep 2026 that is exactly how the OpenAI key and the password pepper were served to the public internet. deploy-web.js builds dist/ from an allow-list, refuses if a secret shape is in it, and tags the deployment with the commit.
scripts.//db:remote: Removed 7 Sep 2026. It applied the old monolithic schema.sql to the PRODUCTION database with -y - no prompt, and bypassing the migration ledger entirely. Production schema changes go through the migration commands below and nothing else.
scripts.//db:migrate:remote: Guarded, and currently REFUSES. Production's ledger is empty while the schema is already at 035, so wrangler sees the full 001-036 history as pending and would replay it against live clinical data. Baseline the ledger first - scripts/migrate-remote.js explains how.

//dependencies: @tharigopula/core is the shared foundation at platform/core in the workspace - primitives, auth and comms that every Tharigopula product uses. A git dependency rather than a file: path so it resolves the same from the main checkout and any worktree, and so a clone on another machine works.
